checks.name: restored-rows
checks.sql:
SELECT json_build_object(
    'rows', count(*), 'min_id', min(id), 'max_id', max(id),
    'bad_payloads', count(*) FILTER (WHERE payload <> md5(id::text)))
    FROM drill.restore_rows

freshness.sql: SELECT to_json(to_char(max(committed_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')) FROM drill.restore_rows
